principle: operational work delivery and experimental evolution are separate deliverables; promotion requires evidence
invariants: VISION != ARTIFACT != BUILD != EXECUTION != EVIDENCE != CLAIM

work.purpose: stable daily Android terminal and package environment

evolution.purpose: continued research and implementation without destabilizing WORK

current_gaps.missing_field: physical execution evidence for source-built pkg/apt/apt-get/dpkg/proot
current_gaps.blocking_dependency: target-device execution with exact package/bootstrap identity
current_gaps.evidence_needed: device transcript plus artifact/package hashes and environment fingerprint
current_gaps.falsifier: any required command fails or resolves to a stub/wrapper rather than the intended backend
current_gaps.next_probe: run bounded package-stack smoke test on target device using pinned app/package revisions
current_gaps.closure_gate: all required package-stack commands execute successfully with receipt

current_gaps.missing_field: paired ARM32 and ARM64 physical evidence
current_gaps.blocking_dependency: validated installations on both required ABI roles
current_gaps.evidence_needed: ARM32 receipt + ARM64 receipt + anti-replay dual-arm matrix
current_gaps.falsifier: one ABI cannot reproduce the required WORK chain
current_gaps.next_probe: capture exact-device receipts for armeabi-v7a and arm64-v8a

current_gaps.missing_field: published/signed RAFCODEPhi binary repository and on-device certificate/DNS/repository validation
current_gaps.evidence_needed: repository snapshot identity, signing receipt, device-side update/install transcript
current_gaps.falsifier: signature, DNS, certificate, repository identity or package install validation fails
current_gaps.next_probe: define a bounded repository snapshot and validate its signing/provenance chain before device use
